already_dead.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的非行动牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌和一张防御牌。
already_dead.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' non-action cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck and a defending card.

anaphylactic_shock.text_zh: 每位本回合对你造成过伤害的对手英雄和盟友失去1点生命。
anaphylactic_shock.text_en: Each opposing hero and ally that has dealt damage to you this turn loses 1{h}.

annihilate_the_armed.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的攻击行动牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
annihilate_the_armed.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' attack action cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

arakni_black_widow.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_black_widow.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——弃一张刺客牌：目标刺客攻击获得+3力量。若其具有隐匿，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。”
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_black_widow.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Discard an Assassin card: Target Assassin attack gets +3{p}. If it has stealth, it gets "When this hits a hero, they banish a card from their hand."
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

arakni_funnel_web.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_funnel_web.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——弃一张刺客牌：目标刺客攻击获得+3力量。若其具有隐匿，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其军械库中的一张牌。”
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_funnel_web.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Discard an Assassin card: Target Assassin attack gets +3{p}. If it has stealth, it gets "When this hits a hero, banish a card in their arsenal."
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

arakni_orb_weaver.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_orb_weaver.text_zh:
石墨烯螯肢的启动费用减少1点资源。
每回合一次瞬间——弃一张刺客牌：装备一个石墨烯螯肢衍生物。本回合你的下一次具有隐匿的攻击获得+3力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_orb_weaver.text_en:
Graphene Chelicerae cost you {r} less to activate.
Once per Turn Instant - Discard an Assassin card: Equip a Graphene Chelicera token. Your next attack with stealth this turn gets +3{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

arakni_redback.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_redback.text_zh:
每回合一次攻击反应——弃一张刺客牌：目标刺客攻击获得+3力量。若其具有隐匿，它获得再动。
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_redback.text_en:
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Discard an Assassin card: Target Assassin attack gets +3{p}. If it has stealth, it gets go again.
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

arakni_tarantula.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_tarantula.text_zh:
每当你拥有的匕首命中英雄时，该英雄失去1点生命。
每回合一次攻击反应——弃一张刺客牌：目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_tarantula.text_en:
Whenever a dagger you own hits a hero, they lose 1{h}.
Once per Turn Attack Reaction - Discard an Assassin card: Target dagger attack gets +3{p}.
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

arakni_trap_door.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 Demi·英雄
arakni_trap_door.text_zh:
当你成为此牌时，你可以从你的牌库中搜寻一张牌，牌面朝下放逐它，然后洗牌。若其为陷阱，直到你的下一个回合开始你可以使用它。
在你的结束阶段开始时，回归巢群。
arakni_trap_door.text_en:
When you become this, you may search your deck for a card, banish it face-down, then shuffle. If it's a trap, you may play it until the start of your next turn.
At the beginning of your end phase, return to the brood.

art_of_desire_body.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张红色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_body.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a red card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

art_of_desire_mind.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张蓝色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_mind.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a blue card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

art_of_desire_soul.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张黄色牌时，抽一张牌并获得1点生命。
art_of_desire_soul.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a yellow card, draw a card and gain 1{h}.

back_stab.text_zh:
隐匿
此链环中防御反应牌不能被使用。
back_stab.text_en:
Stealth
Defense reaction cards can't be played this chain link.

beckoning_mistblade.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
beckoning_mistblade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌命中时，你本回合的下一次蓝色攻击获得+1力量和再动。
beckoning_mistblade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this hits, your next blue attack this turn gets +1{p} and go again.

bite.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以让你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。
bite.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks a hero, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger.

bloodrot_trap.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 防御反应·陷阱
bloodrot_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御且攻击英雄在此链环中使用或启动过反应时，在其控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。
bloodrot_trap.text_en: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated a reaction this chain link, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

bonds_of_agony.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过3张或更多攻击反应，此牌获得+3力量，以及"当此牌命中英雄时，查看其手牌并选择一张牌。搜寻其手牌、牌库和坟场，并放逐至多3张与所选牌同名的牌。该英雄洗牌。"
bonds_of_agony.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated 3 or more attack reactions this chain link, this gets +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card. Search their hand, deck, and graveyard and banish up to 3 cards with the same name as the chosen card. They shuffle."

bonds_of_attraction.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌，然后放逐其坟场中的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张牌且此牌已放逐过另一张同色的牌时，获得1点生命。
bonds_of_attraction.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck, then banish a card from their graveyard.
Whenever this banishes a card and this has banished another card with the same color, gain 1{h}.

bonds_of_memory.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌，然后放逐其坟场中的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张牌且此牌已放逐过另一张同名的牌时，获得1点生命。
bonds_of_memory.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck, then banish a card from their graveyard.
Whenever this banishes a card and this has banished another card with the same name, gain 1{h}.

codex_of_bloodrot.text_zh:
每位英雄将手牌中的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。
在你控制下创造一个沉思衍生物，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。
再动
codex_of_bloodrot.text_en:
Each hero puts a card from their hand face-down into their arsenal.
Create a Ponder token under your control and a Bloodrot Pox token under each opponent's control.
Go again

codex_of_frailty.text_zh:
每位英雄将其坟场中的一张攻击行动牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。每位以此方式做法的英雄弃一张牌。
在你控制下创造一个沉思衍生物，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。
再动
codex_of_frailty.text_en:
Each hero puts an attack action card from their graveyard face down into their arsenal. Each hero that does, discards a card.
Create a Ponder token under your control and a Frailty token under each opponent's control.
Go again

codex_of_inertia.text_zh:
每位英雄将其牌库顶的一张牌牌面朝下放入其军械库。每位以此方式做法的英雄弃一张牌。
在你控制下创造一个沉思衍生物，并在每位对手的控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。
再动
codex_of_inertia.text_en:
Each hero puts the top card of their deck face down into their arsenal. Each hero that does, discards a card.
Create a Ponder token under your control and an Inertia token under each opponent's control.
Go again

coercive_tendency.text_zh:
阿拉克尼专精
查看防御英雄牌库顶的3张牌。以任意顺序放回，然后放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
若你以此方式完成一份契约，本战斗链中你的刺客攻击获得再动。
coercive_tendency.text_en:
Arakni Specialization
Look at the top 3 cards of the defending hero's deck. Put them back in any order, then banish the top card of their deck.
If you complete a contract this way, your Assassin attacks get go again this combat chain.

creep.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张具有隐匿的攻击获得再动。
creep.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks, the next attack with stealth you play this combat chain gets go again.

cut_to_the_chase.text_zh:
目标具有契约的刺客攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
查看防御英雄牌库顶的一张牌。你可以将其置于牌库底。
cut_to_the_chase.text_en:
Target Assassin attack action card with contract gains +3{p}.
Look at the top card of the defending hero's deck. You may put it on the bottom.

death_touch.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 行动·攻击
death_touch.text_zh:
死亡之触不能从手牌使用。
当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个虚弱、惰性或血腐疫病衍生物。
death_touch.text_en:
Death Touch can't be played from hand.
When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

defang_the_dragon.text_zh:
隐匿
契约——你受契约束缚以命中一位名为方格的被标记英雄。每当你完成此契约时，抽一张牌。
defang_the_dragon.text_en:
Stealth
Contract - You are contracted to hit a marked hero named Fang. Whenever you complete this contract, draw a card.

desires_of_flesh.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张攻击行动牌时，获得1点生命。
desires_of_flesh.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes an attack action card, gain 1{h}.

double_trouble.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过2张或更多攻击反应，此牌获得+2力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的2张牌。”
double_trouble.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated 2 or more attack reactions this chain link, this gets +2{p} and "When this hits a hero, banish the top 2 cards of their deck."

eradicate.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的黄色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的X张牌，X为根除造成的伤害。
eradicate.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' yellow cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top X cards of their deck, where X is the damage dealt by Eradicate.

excessive_bloodloss.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的红色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。若其为红色，重复此过程一次。
excessive_bloodloss.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. If it's red, repeat this process once.

extinguish_the_flames.text_zh:
隐匿
契约——你受契约束缚以命中一位名为辛德拉的被标记英雄。每当你完成此契约时，抽一张牌。
extinguish_the_flames.text_en:
Stealth
Contract - You are contracted to hit a marked hero named Cindra. Whenever you complete this contract, draw a card.

fang_strike.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
fang_strike.text_zh:
短暂
目标攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
fang_strike.text_en:
Ephemeral
Target attack action card gets +1{p}.

fleece_the_frail.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的防御为2或更低的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
fleece_the_frail.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with 2 or less {d}. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

frailty_trap.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 防御反应·陷阱
frailty_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御具有再动的攻击时，在攻击英雄的控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。
frailty_trap.text_en: When this defends an attack with go again, create a Frailty token under the attacking hero's control.

gorgons_gaze.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
gorgons_gaze.text_zh:
在你的手牌中创造一张滑行。
放逐战斗链上的所有防御攻击行动牌。若你为使用此牌资源过一张气，本战斗链中你可以不支付费用使用被放逐的牌。
gorgons_gaze.text_en:
Create a Slither in your hand.
Banish all defending attack action cards on the combat chain. If a Chi was pitched to play this, you may play the banished cards this combat chain without paying their {r} cost.

graphene_chelicera.type_zh: 刺客 衍生物 武器·匕首 （单手）
graphene_chelicera.text_zh:
隐匿
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
当此牌攻击被标记的英雄时，该攻击获得再动。
graphene_chelicera.text_en:
Stealth
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
When this attacks a marked hero, the attack gets go again.

graven_call.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
graven_call.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
瞬间——摧毁你控制的2个银币：带有一个+1力量指示物地装备此牌。仅当此牌在你坟场中时才能启动此异能。
graven_call.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
Instant - Destroy 2 Silver you control: Equip this with a +1{p} counter. Activate this ability only while this is in your graveyard.

hiss.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
hiss.text_zh:
目标刺客或秘法攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张滑行。
hiss.text_en:
Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +3{p}.
If you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Slither in your hand.

horrors_of_the_past.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击时，它获得你控制的战斗链上最后一张具有隐匿的攻击行动牌的基础异能。
horrors_of_the_past.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks, it gets the base abilities of the last attack action card with stealth you control on the combat chain.

hunted_or_hunter.type_zh: 刺客 防御反应·陷阱
hunted_or_hunter.text_zh: 当此牌防御且攻击英雄在此链环中使用或启动过攻击反应时，该英雄失去1点生命。
hunted_or_hunter.text_en: When this defends and the attacking hero has played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, they lose 1{h}.

hunter_or_hunted.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，说出一张牌名。攻击英雄展示其牌库顶的一张牌。若其为被说出的牌，放逐它，搜寻其手牌、牌库和军械库中至多3张具有该名称的牌并放逐它们，然后该英雄洗牌。
契约——当此牌防御时，你受契约束缚以放逐对手的具有所选名称的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
hunter_or_hunted.text_en:
When this defends, name a card. The attacking hero reveals the top card of their deck. If it's the named card, banish it, search their hand, deck, and arsenal for up to 3 cards with that name and banish them, then they shuffle.
Contract - While this is defending, you are contracted to banish opponents' cards with the chosen name. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.

hunters_klaive.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
hunters_klaive.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
穿透1
hunters_klaive.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this hits a hero, mark them.
Piercing 1

impulsive_desire.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张反应或瞬间牌时，获得1点生命。
impulsive_desire.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a reaction or instant card, gain 1{h}.

inertia_trap.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 防御反应·陷阱
inertia_trap.text_zh: 当此牌防御力量大于其基础的攻击时，在攻击英雄的控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。
inertia_trap.text_en: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, create an Inertia token under the attacking hero's control.

infect.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。
infect.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

infiltrate.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。直到你的下一个回合结束你可以使用它。
infiltrate.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. You may play it until the end of your next turn.

intimate_inducement.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
intimate_inducement.text_zh:
目标刺客或秘法攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
查看防御英雄牌库顶的4张牌并选择一张牌。若其为蓝色，它具有0点基础防御。将所选牌作为防御牌放入当前链环，并将其余牌以任意顺序置于牌库顶。
intimate_inducement.text_en:
Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +1{p}.
Look at the top 4 cards of the defending hero's deck and choose a card. If it's blue, it has 0 base {d}. Put the chosen card onto the active chain link as a defending card and the rest on top in any order.

just_a_nick.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
- 目标基础力量为1或更低的攻击行动牌获得+5力量。
- 目标具有隐匿的攻击获得“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。”

kiss_of_death.type_zh: 刺客 行动·匕首 攻击
kiss_of_death.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去1点生命。
kiss_of_death.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, they lose 1{h}.

knife_through.text_zh:
隐匿
若本战斗链中你用匕首命中过，此牌获得再动。
knife_through.text_en:
Stealth
If you've hit with a dagger this combat chain, this gets go again.

leave_no_witnesses.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的红色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌和其军械库中的至多1张牌。
leave_no_witnesses.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' red cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck and up to 1 card in their arsenal.

lobotomy.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击时，你可以从你的物品栏装备一把奥比托克拉斯。
当此牌命中英雄时，若你控制一把奥比托克拉斯，该英雄在其下一个行动阶段期间失去所有英雄牌异能。
lobotomy.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks, you may equip an Orbitoclast from your inventory.
When this hits a hero, if you control an Orbitoclast, they lose all hero card abilities during their next action phase.

malign.text_zh:
隐匿
恶意将造成的伤害不能被防止。
malign.text_en:
Stealth
Damage that would be dealt by Malign can't be prevented.

mark_of_the_black_widow.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中被标记的英雄时，该英雄放逐其手牌中的一张牌。
mark_of_the_black_widow.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a marked hero, they banish a card from their hand.

mark_of_the_funnel_web.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中被标记的英雄时，放逐其军械库中的一张牌。
mark_of_the_funnel_web.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a marked hero, banish a card in their arsenal.

mark_of_the_huntsman.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
mark_of_the_huntsman.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌命中英雄时，你可以选择摧毁此牌并标记该英雄。
若此牌正在攻击被标记的英雄，此牌获得+1力量。
mark_of_the_huntsman.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this hits a hero, you may choose to destroy this and mark them.
If this is attacking a marked hero, this gets +1{p}.

mark_the_prey.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
mark_the_prey.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, mark them.

meet_madness.type_zh: 混沌 刺客 行动·攻击
meet_madness.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，随机选择其一；
- 该英雄选择其手牌中的一张牌。放逐它。
- 该英雄选择其军械库中的一张牌。放逐它。
- 放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
meet_madness.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, choose 1 at random;
- They choose a card in their hand. Banish it.
- They choose a card in their arsenal. Banish it.
- Banish the top card of their deck.

minds_desire.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张非攻击行动牌时，获得1点生命。
minds_desire.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes a non-attack action card, gain 1{h}.

mist_hunter.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的蓝色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中秘法英雄时，搜寻其牌库中任意数量的内息并放逐它们。然后洗牌。
mist_hunter.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' blue cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a Mystic hero, search their deck for any number of Inner Chi and banish them. Then shuffle.

nerve_scalpel.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
nerve_scalpel.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄下一次用1张或更多反应牌防御时，那些牌在防御时获得-1防御。
nerve_scalpel.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more reaction cards this turn, those cards have -1{d} while defending.

nights_embrace.text_zh: 本回合你的具有隐匿的攻击获得+1力量。
nights_embrace.text_en: Your attacks with stealth get +1{p} this turn.

nix_the_nimble.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的反应牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
nix_the_nimble.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' reaction cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

orb_weaver_spinneret.text_zh:
装备一个石墨烯螯肢衍生物。
本回合你的下一次具有隐匿的攻击获得+3力量。
再动
orb_weaver_spinneret.text_en:
Equip a Graphene Chelicera token.
Your next attack with stealth this turn gets +3{p}.
Go again

orbitoclast.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
orbitoclast.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄下一次用1张或更多“非攻击”行动牌防御时，那些牌在防御时获得-1防御。
orbitoclast.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more 'non-attack' action cards this turn, those cards have -1{d} while defending.

pay_day.text_zh: 若本回合你完成过一份契约，创造4个银币衍生物。
pay_day.text_en: If you've completed a contract this turn, create 4 Silver tokens.

persuasive_prognosis.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。然后查看其手牌并放逐一张与被放逐的牌同色的牌。
每当此牌放逐一张行动牌时，获得1点生命。
persuasive_prognosis.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck. Then look at their hand and banish a card with the same color as the banished card.
Whenever this banishes an action card, gain 1{h}.

pick_to_pieces.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过攻击反应，此牌获得+1力量，以及“此牌将造成的伤害不能被防止。”
pick_to_pieces.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, this gets +1{p} and "Damage that would be dealt by this can't be prevented."

plague_hive.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 资源·宝石
plague_hive.text_zh:
传奇
当你将瘟疫蜂巢资源时，为每位对手英雄在惰性、虚弱或血腐疫病中随机选择一种，并在其控制下创造该衍生物。
plague_hive.text_en:
Legendary
When you pitch Plague Hive, for each opposing hero, choose Inertia, Frailty, or Bloodrot Pox at random and create that token under their control.

plunder_the_poor.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的费用为1或更低的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
plunder_the_poor.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with cost 1 or less. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

plunge_the_prospect.text_zh:
隐匿
若此牌正在攻击被标记的英雄，此牌获得+1力量。
plunge_the_prospect.text_en:
Stealth
If this is attacking a marked hero, this gets +1{p}.

prowl.text_zh:
隐匿
本战斗链中你使用的下一张具有隐匿的攻击获得+1力量。
prowl.text_en:
Stealth
The next attack with stealth you play this combat chain gains +1{p}.

razors_edge.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
razors_edge.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gets +3{p}.

reapers_call.text_zh:
隐匿
瞬间——弃掉此牌：标记目标对手英雄。
reapers_call.text_en:
Stealth
Instant - Discard this: Mark target opposing hero.

regicide.text_zh:
传奇阿拉克尼专精
当此牌命中皇族英雄时，该英雄输掉游戏。
当战斗链关闭时，你输掉游戏。
弑君不能被与防御英雄放逐区中的牌同名的牌防御。
regicide.text_en:
Legendary Arakni Specialization
When this hits a Royal hero, they lose the game.
When the combat chain closes, you lose the game.
Regicide can't be defended by cards with the same name as cards in the defending hero's banished zone.

rob_the_rich.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的费用为2或更高的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
rob_the_rich.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with cost 2 or greater. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

sack_the_shifty.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的具有基础再动的牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
sack_the_shifty.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' cards with base go again. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

sacred_art_undercurrent_desires.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 瞬间
sacred_art_undercurrent_desires.text_zh:
传奇
若本回合你使用过另一张蓝色牌，选择3个。否则，选择1个；
- 在你的手牌中创造一张獠牙突袭和滑行。
- 放逐一位对手英雄坟场中的至多2张牌。
- 超越
sacred_art_undercurrent_desires.text_en:
Legendary
If you've played another blue card this turn, choose 3. Otherwise, choose 1;
- Create a Fang Strike and Slither in your hand.
- Banish up to 2 cards in an opposing hero's graveyard.
- Transcend

scale_peeler.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
scale_peeler.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄下一次用1件或更多装备防御时，那些装备在防御时获得-1防御。
scale_peeler.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more equipment this turn, those equipment have -1{d} while defending.

scuttle_the_canal.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击被标记的英雄时，此牌获得再动。
scuttle_the_canal.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks a marked hero, this gets go again.

sedate.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。
sedate.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control.

seeker_kunai.text_zh:
攻击反应——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：目标刺客攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
当此牌在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以摧毁你控制的2个银币。若如此做，将此牌移回竞技场。
seeker_kunai.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Target Assassin attack action card gets +1{p}.
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silver you control. If you do, return this to the arena.

serpents_kiss.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 行动·攻击
serpents_kiss.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击时，在你的手牌中创造一张獠牙突袭或滑行。若本回合你超越过，改为创造两者。
当此牌命中英雄时，查看其牌库顶的2张牌。放逐其中一张。
serpents_kiss.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks, create a Fang Strike or Slither in your hand. If you've transcended this turn, instead create both.
When this hits a hero, look at the top 2 cards of their deck. Banish 1 of them.

shake_down.text_zh:
乌祖里专精
若此链环中你使用或启动过攻击反应，敲诈勒索获得“当此牌命中英雄时，选择红色、黄色或蓝色。该英雄展示其手牌。放逐一张所选颜色的牌。”
shake_down.text_en:
Uzuri Specialization
If you've played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, Shake Down has "When this hits a hero, choose red, yellow, or blue. They reveal their hand. Banish a card of the chosen color."

shred.text_zh: 本战斗链中目标防御刺客攻击的牌获得-4防御。
shred.text_en: Target card defending an Assassin attack gets -4{d} this combat chain.

sirens_call.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
sirens_call.text_zh: 查看防御英雄的手牌并选择一张蓝色牌。将其作为防御牌加入此链环。若如此做，抽一张牌。
sirens_call.text_en: Look at the defending hero's hand and choose a blue card. Add it to this chain link as a defending card. If you do, draw a card.

slay_the_scholars.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的“非攻击”行动牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
slay_the_scholars.text_en:
Contract - You are contracted to banish opponents' 'non-attack' action cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.

slither.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
slither.text_zh:
短暂
目标攻击行动牌获得再动。
slither.text_en:
Ephemeral
Target attack action card gets go again.

sneak_attack.text_zh: 若此链环中你使用或启动过攻击反应，偷袭获得+4力量。
sneak_attack.text_en: If you've played or activated an attack reaction this chain link, Sneak Attack has +4{p}.

spiders_bite.type_zh: 刺客 武器·匕首 （单手）
spiders_bite.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
穿透1
当此牌命中英雄时，本回合该英雄下一次用1张或更多攻击行动牌防御时，那些牌在防御时获得-1防御。
spiders_bite.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
Piercing 1
When this hits a hero, the next time they defend with 1 or more attack action cards this turn, those cards have -1{d} while defending.

spike_with_bloodrot.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。”
spike_with_bloodrot.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Bloodrot Pox token under their control."

spike_with_frailty.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个虚弱衍生物。”
spike_with_frailty.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create a Frailty token under their control."

spike_with_inertia.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个惰性衍生物。”
spike_with_inertia.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gains +3{p} and "When this hits a hero, create an Inertia token under their control."

spreading_plague.text_zh: 在防御英雄的控制下创造X个血腐疫病衍生物，X为此链环的防御牌数量。
spreading_plague.text_en: Create X Bloodrot Pox tokens under the defending hero's control, where X is the number of defending cards this chain link.

stains_of_the_redback.text_zh:
若防御英雄已被标记，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
目标具有隐匿的攻击获得+3力量和再动。
stains_of_the_redback.text_en:
If the defending hero is marked, this costs {r} less to play.
Target attack with stealth gets +3{p} and go again.

surgical_extraction.text_zh:
契约——你受契约束缚以放逐对手的蓝色牌。每当你完成此契约时，创造一个银币衍生物。
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌，然后查看其手牌并放逐一张牌。
surgical_extraction.text_en:
Contract  - You are contracted to banish opponents' blue cards. Whenever you complete this contract, create a Silver token.
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck, then look at their hand and banish a card.

take_up_the_mantle.text_zh: 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。若它正在攻击被标记的英雄，改为它获得+3力量，且你可以放逐你坟场中的一张具有隐匿的攻击行动牌。若如此做，目标成为被放逐的牌的复制品。
take_up_the_mantle.text_en: Target attack action card with stealth gets +2{p}. If it's attacking a marked hero, instead it gets +3{p} and you may banish an attack action card with stealth from your graveyard. If you do, the target becomes a copy of the banished card.

tarantula_toxin.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。
本回合目标防御具有隐匿的攻击的牌获得-3防御。

tide_chakra.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
tide_chakra.text_zh: 目标刺客或秘法攻击行动牌获得+3力量。若本回合你超越过，改为它获得+5力量。
tide_chakra.text_en: Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +3{p}. If you've transcended this turn, instead it gets +5{p}.

toxicity.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张刺客或游侠攻击行动牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去5点生命。”
再动
toxicity.text_en:
The next Assassin or Ranger attack action card you play this turn gains "When this hits a hero, they lose 5{h}."
Go again

two_sides_to_the_blade.text_zh:
选择其一；
- 目标匕首攻击获得+3力量。
- 目标具有隐匿的攻击行动牌获得+3力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。”

under_the_trap_door.text_zh:
隐匿
瞬间——弃掉此牌：放逐你坟场中的目标陷阱。若如此做，本回合你可以使用它，且若本回合它将置入坟场，改为放逐它。
under_the_trap_door.text_en:
Stealth
Instant - Discard this: Banish target trap from your graveyard. If you do, you may play it this turn and if it would be put into the graveyard this turn, instead banish it.

undercover_acquisition.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，偷取其控制的一个物品。
undercover_acquisition.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, steal an item they control.

unmake_the_underlings.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌攻击英雄时，将其坟场中的一个盟友翻为牌面朝下。
当此牌命中盟友时，摧毁该盟友。
unmake_the_underlings.text_en:
Stealth
When this attacks a hero, turn an ally in their graveyard face-down.
When this hits an ally, destroy that ally.

venomous_bite.type_zh: 秘法 刺客 攻击反应
venomous_bite.text_zh:
目标刺客或秘法攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张獠牙突袭。
venomous_bite.text_en:
Target Assassin or Mystic attack action card gets +3{p}.
If you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Fang Strike in your hand.

virulent_touch.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 行动·攻击
virulent_touch.text_zh:
剧毒之触不能从手牌使用。
当此链环结算时，若剧毒之触被一张来自手牌的牌防御，在防御英雄的控制下创造一个血腐疫病衍生物。
virulent_touch.text_en:
Virulent Touch can't be played from hand.
When this chain link resolves, if Virulent Touch is defended by a card from hand, create a Bloodrot Pox token under the defending hero's control.

whittle_from_bone.text_zh:
隐匿
